nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping of account balances (_balances).
ERC20 private nested mapping of owner->spender->amount allowances (_allowances).
ERC20 private total supply counter (_totalSupply).
ERC20 private token name string (_name).
ERC20 private token symbol string (_symbol).
GeneratorCopyright private version string (_version).
Context._msgSender internal view virtual returning msg.sender.
ERC20._transfer internal virtual; performs balance arithmetic and emits Transfer.
ERC20._mint internal virtual; increases _totalSupply and recipient balance.
ERC20._burn internal virtual; decreases balance and _totalSupply.
ERC20._approve internal virtual; writes _allowances and emits Approval.
ERC20.transfer public; moves tokens from _msgSender to recipient.
ERC20.approve public; sets allowance from _msgSender to spender.
ERC20.transferFrom public; spends allowance and moves tokens between accounts.
ERC20.increaseAllowance public; adds addedValue to existing allowance.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance public; subtracts subtractedValue from existing allowance.
SimpleERC20 payable constructor; validates supply and mints to deployer.
ServicePayer payable constructor; forwards msg.value to fee receiver via external call.
IPayable.pay external payable interface function invoked by ServicePayer.
msg.sender, the caller identity returned by _msgSender.
msg.value forwarded by the ServicePayer constructor to the fee receiver.
External call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) executed in ServicePayer constructor.
Subtraction senderBalance - amount performed in _transfer.
Addition _balances[recipient] += amount performed in _transfer.
Addition _allowances[_msgSender][spender] + addedValue in increaseAllowance.
Subtraction currentAllowance - amount performed in transferFrom.
recipient address parameter of transfer and _transfer.
amount uint256 parameter of transfer and _transfer.
spender address parameter of approve, increaseAllowance, decreaseAllowance and _approve.
addedValue uint256 parameter of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue uint256 parameter of decreaseAllowance.
sender address parameter of transferFrom and _transfer.
account address parameter of balanceOf, _mint and _burn.
initialBalance_ uint256 parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor, minted at deployment.
receiver address payable parameter of the ServicePayer constructor, target of the fee external call.
serviceName string parameter passed to the fee receiver pay call.
name_ string parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor.
symbol_ string parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor.
feeReceiver_ address payable parameter of the SimpleERC20 constructor forwarded to ServicePayer.
owner address parameter of _approve.
currentAllowance local variable in transferFrom holding the spender allowance.
senderBalance local variable in _transfer holding the sender balance.
accountBalance local variable in _burn holding the account balance.

edges.reason: Context._msgSender returns the untrusted caller msg.sender.
transfer uses _msgSender as the token source account.
approve uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom uses _msgSender as the spender whose allowance is consumed.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender as the allowance owner.
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the whole initial supply to _msgSender (the deployer).
Deployer identity msg.sender receives the full initial token supply.
msg.value is forwarded as the value of the external pay call in the ServicePayer constructor.
ServicePayer constructor consumes msg.value for the fee payment.
ServicePayer constructor invokes the external IPayable.pay interface function on the fee receiver.
ServicePayer constructor performs the external payable call to an attacker-supplied receiver address.
transfer delegates to the internal _transfer routine.
approve delegates to the internal _approve routine.
transferFrom delegates token movement to _transfer.
transferFrom re-approves the reduced allowance via _approve.
increaseAllowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the new allowance via _approve.
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the initial balance through _mint.
SimpleERC20 constructor invokes the ServicePayer base constructor which performs the fee payment.
_transfer reads and writes the _balances mapping.
_mint credits the recipient entry of _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn debits the account entry of _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes the owner/spender entry of _allowances.
transferFrom reads and rewrites _allowances for the spender.
increaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance entry of _allowances.
decreaseAllowance reads and writes the allowance entry of _allowances.
_transfer computes senderBalance - amount, an arithmetic operation.
_transfer computes _balances[recipient] += amount, an arithmetic operation.
increaseAllowance computes existing allowance + addedValue, an arithmetic operation.
transferFrom computes currentAllowance - amount, an arithmetic operation.
recipient parameter feeds the public transfer entry point.
recipient parameter feeds _transfer destination.
amount parameter is the value transferred by transfer.
amount parameter feeds the balance arithmetic in _transfer.
spender parameter sets the approval target in approve.
spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in _approve.
addedValue parameter consumed by increaseAllowance.
addedValue is the operand of the allowance addition.
subtractedValue parameter consumed by decreaseAllowance.
sender parameter determines whose allowance is spent in transferFrom.
sender parameter feeds _transfer source account.
account parameter receives the minted balance in _mint.
account parameter is debited by _burn.
initialBalance_ parameter is validated and minted by the SimpleERC20 constructor.
initialBalance_ is passed as the amount to _mint.
receiver parameter becomes the target of the external fee call in the ServicePayer constructor.
receiver is the callee address of the unsafe external pay call.
serviceName parameter is forwarded by the ServicePayer constructor.
serviceName is passed into IPayable.pay.
name_ parameter sets the token name in the constructor.
symbol_ parameter sets the token symbol in the constructor.
feeReceiver_ parameter is the payable fee destination supplied by the deployer.
feeReceiver_ is forwarded as the receiver argument of the ServicePayer constructor.
owner parameter indexes the _allowances mapping in _approve.
currentAllowance local is read from _allowances inside transferFrom.
currentAllowance is the minuend of the allowance subtraction.
senderBalance local is read from _balances inside _transfer.
senderBalance is the minuend of the transfer subtraction.
accountBalance local is read from _balances inside _burn.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a public transfer argument that flows directly into the transfer entry point.
amount is the value manipulated by the balance arithmetic inside _transfer.
spender is the mapping key written by _approve when setting allowances.
addedValue exists only to be added to the caller allowance in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue exists only to be subtracted from the caller allowance in decreaseAllowance.
sender is the source account consumed by _transfer balance arithmetic.
account is the credited address of the _mint supply operation.
initialBalance_ is validated and consumed by the SimpleERC20 constructor deployment logic.
receiver address is only used as the target of the constructor external pay call.
serviceName is only forwarded by the ServicePayer constructor to the fee receiver.
name_ is consumed by the constructor to initialise the token name.
symbol_ is consumed by the constructor to initialise the token symbol.
feeReceiver_ is only forwarded by the constructor into the ServicePayer fee payment.
owner is the mapping key set by _approve when writing allowances.
currentAllowance is a temporary local only meaningful inside transferFrom.
senderBalance is a temporary local only meaningful inside _transfer.
accountBalance is a temporary local only meaningful inside _burn.
